Second Luna rework tightened checker placement/function scope, removed completed-to-committed and unknownResult mutation gaps, moved caller guards, tested hydration cross-source behavior, and added deferred timeout-to-unknown/late-completion/reconcile/no-retry proof.
Claude final read-only review accepted the local T0+T1 result; no further rework was required.
No Claude internal subagent claim is made beyond the two evidenced read-only subreviews in the final full-delta report.
claudeAdvisories: Mutation probes are not CI-wired: MUTATION_TEST=1 was run manually, while the CI check runs only the base assertion.

The protocol test fake DB is synchronous/non-concurrent and does not prove real Postgres concurrency atomicity; the production INSERT..ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING path was source-reviewed, not runtime-proven here.
The orphaned late mutation promise lacks a catch; a later transport rejection could surface as an unhandled rejection.

Reconcile timeout/availability handling is asymmetric: invocation maps deadline to unknown, while reconcile can throw; a point-in-time read can transiently report still_running before a late completion.
Local acceptance does not close hosted CI, staging, deployment, browser, provider, database, production, or external release gates.
